The '''Thory Prime system''',<ref name="EAOC" /> also known as the '''Thory system''', was located in the [[Thory sector/Legends|Thory sector]],<ref name="EGtW" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Baltizaar system/Legends|Baltizaar system]] of the [[Corthenia sector/Legends|Corthenia sector]] and the [[Dohu system/Legends|Dohu system]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Dohu sector/Legends|same name]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Thory Prime system lay within territory controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thory Prime system was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square K-7.<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', noted on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that Thory Prime was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that every sector listed in the Online Companion would have at least one corresponding system.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archivedate=20191013233754|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref> The [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' introduced the alternate designation "Thory system."<ref name="EGtW" />
